actual_scope: Kernel-check all-prefix finite-symbol closure and fixed primitive-action depth for source-extracted pinned MathlibTM2 semantics; audit the FinTM2 premise boundary requested by PR2411.
scope_change_reason: The selected HPE bindings already have substantial exact and formal coverage. PR2411 explicitly requests independent machine/time-model review; FinTM2 only assumes finite input alphabet, so reachable internal-symbol finiteness deserves an explicit source-bound proof.
bottleneck_link: Clarifies the finite-machine interpretation of an external completed theorem without transferring its smaller saving to the selected conditional supplier.
stop_rule: Keep the proof on actual extracted statement semantics and complete finite control/label enumerations. Do not claim full Mathlib instantiation, a tape compiler, or a rebuilt multiplication theorem.
evidence: Fresh Lean4.34.1 isolated kernel replay passed four transitive axiom reports, using only propext/Quot.sound. Source extraction,1533 finite cases,6 semantic and7 reporting controls pass. Separate AI source/proof review independently repeated the full dedicated kernel command successfully; no blocker found.
